title: Invisible Filters: Cultural Bias in Hiring Evaluations Using Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper investigates cultural, regional, gender, and caste-based bias in hiring evaluations performed by LLMs. While it references the socioreligious category of caste and operates within an ethical framework of fairness, it does not specifically benchmark or evaluate religion, faith traditions, theological concepts, or systems of moral/ethical reasoning as the primary subject matter.
